Current imports explicitly refer to torch/c10/CUDA/system DLLs, and contain no HYLE private import or opposite-facade dependency. Each facade link resolves private static HYLE definitions inside its own image.

finite_contract_clarification.msvc_whitelist: No subtractive native linker whitelist is claimed or needed. Microsoft documents .DEF EXPORTS and __declspec(dllexport) as compatible additive export mechanisms; .DEF PRIVATE only omits an entry from generated import library and does not remove the actual DLL export. A one-entry .DEF or PRIVATE cannot be presented as eliminating these77 original directives.
